hints.content:
To measure slope, we pick any two points on the line. Then we look at the horizontal and vertical distances between those points.



[[☃ image 1]]

options.alt: A coordinate plane. The x- and y-axes each scale by one. A graph of a line intersects the points negative three, two and one, negative one. There is a horizontal dotted segment from negative three, two to one, two that is labeled four. There is a vertical  dotted segment from one, two to one, negative one that is labeled negative three.

hints.content: The slope of the line is $-\dfrac{3}{4}$.
